name: Salary motivation
description: Watch your scheduled work turn into estimated earnings. Offline and stored only after you save.
anchor: First work day of the cycle
calendarHint: Select dates to switch work and rest. A single-date exception never shifts the cycle. Fixed-rest mode requires exactly the chosen number of rest dates.
showBar: Show salary bar in LisTools pages
pipHelp: Keep this source tab open. The floating window closes with this tab or Chrome; reopening recalculates scheduled earnings.
storageNote: Salary and schedule are saved only with Save and enable. Display buttons remember your visibility preferences. Browser data is local, not encrypted or synced; no upload. Enter expected net salary for a take-home estimate.
scopeNote: Same-day shifts only. Confirm holidays and adjusted work days yourself. This estimates earned salary, not a bank deposit or payroll record.
calendarSummary: {{work}} work days · {{rest}} rest days. Fixed-rest selection: {{selected}} / {{expected}}.
planStats: {{work}} work days · {{rest}} rest days · {{hours}} planned hours
completeSchedule: Complete valid cycle and date settings to preview the calendar.
draftNotice: Unsaved changes. The live amount still uses the saved settings.
externalNotice: Settings changed in another page. Your draft is preserved; saving will replace the active settings.
recalcConfirm: Saving applies these settings to the whole current month. The estimated amount may increase or decrease. Continue?
clearConfirm: Clear only salary settings from this browser? Other LisTools data stays unchanged.
saved: Saved on this browser. Earnings have been recalculated.
notSaved: Not saved. Browser storage is unavailable; these settings work only on this page and its floating window.
localDisplayOnly: Only on this page and its floating window.
saveConflict: Settings changed in another page. Review and confirm your draft again.
clearConflict: The active schedule changed. Review it before confirming deletion again.
clearFailed: Could not clear the saved browser data. Disabled on this page; try clearing again later.
pipUnsupported: This browser does not support a desktop Picture-in-Picture window. The dashboard and salary bar remain available.
pipFailed: The desktop window could not be opened. Open it from this visible page with a direct click.
invalidSalary: Enter a positive monthly amount with at most two decimal places.
invalidHours: Enter positive paid hours up to 24, in whole minutes.
invalidLunch: The unpaid break must fit completely inside the shift.
overnight: This shift crosses midnight. Only same-day shifts are supported.
invalidCycle: Work days must be a positive integer and rest days a nonnegative integer.
invalidDate: Enter valid dates in the active month and a valid cycle start date.
invalidRest: Rest days must be a nonnegative integer smaller than this month’s day count.
restCount: Select exactly the configured number of rest dates before saving.
noWork: The month needs at least one paid work interval.
ambiguousTime: {{date}} at {{time}} ({{zone}}) is missing or repeated. Adjust the work or break time.
invalidTimeZone: The saved calculation timezone is invalid.
invalidConfig: Salary settings are invalid or use an unsupported version.
encourage_unconfigured: Set your salary and schedule, then enable the estimate.
encourage_pending: A new month is ready. Confirm its rest dates to calculate earnings.
encourage_before: A fresh day is ahead. Start at your own pace.
encourage_working: Your time is becoming visible income, one moment at a time.
encourage_lunch: Take a proper break. The estimate will resume with work.
encourage_after: Good work today. Leave some time for life.
encourage_rest: Rest is part of a good working life.
encourage_error: Review your saved times and calendar before continuing.
privacy: Salary and schedule are stored locally only after saving; never uploaded.
zoneHelp: Changing the timezone edits this draft only. Save and confirm to recalculate.
monthReset: A new month has started. Previous-month date selections were cleared. Review this calendar before saving.
modeDrafts: Each schedule keeps its own date selections for this month. Switching back restores them.
dateDraftReset: Date selections for this schedule were cleared.
zoneMonthReset: The selected timezone is in a different month. Previous-month date selections were cleared; review this calendar before saving.
applyHolidays: Apply mainland China holidays and makeup days
holidaySource: Mainland China · {{year}} · offline data {{version}}. Only published dates are overridden; other dates keep your schedule.
noMonthHolidays: No listed holidays or makeup days this month.
holidaysUnavailable: No bundled published holiday data for {{year}}. Set dates manually; no holiday schedule is assumed.
holidaysDraft: Holiday dates applied to the draft. Save to change the estimate. The fixed-month rest target stays unchanged; resolve any count mismatch first.
